We are pleased to introduce an innovative mobile banking MedMobile, designed with a wide range of online services that enable you to bank with us at your convenience in a seamless and secure way. 


With MedMobile you can manage your account, loan, card, transfers and many other services for you and your company from the comfort of your mobile or electronic pad at any time wherever you are.

MedMobile empowers you to access your banking services faster than ever, either through your biometrics, touch ID or  facial ID whatever you choose!

Avail yourself from MedMobile key services: 
-	Get a complete view of your accounts and transactions with ease.
-	Transfer your funds to accounts at Bankmed and to other local and international destination accounts.
-	Grow your wealth throughout the Wealth Management service. 
-	Set up a recurring instruction for monthly payments.
-	Automate your favorite transfers.
-	Trade online. 
-	Settle  your payment dues for cards and loans.
-	Track your card spending. 
-	Access your online rewards. 
-	Manage your spending by setting your goals. 
-	Block a lost or stolen card instantly.
-	Mange your card with the  following services: checkbook request and any others… 
-	View Bankmed offers.
-	Request Line of Credit (LCs) and Letter of Guarantees(LGs).
-	Execute and track progress of the main services available in your banking halls.
-	Locate your nearest Bankmed’s Branch, e-Branch, e-Zone, Smart ATM and ATM
-	Communicate with us 24/7 round the clock.
-	And much more …

Download MedMobile By Bankmed and discover how banking on the go is easier than ever!
